name: Mayfair Lang
source: He is a researcher of animal cybernetics (cyborgs of animals).He was a former officer of the forest, but when Sías came to work, he became a laboratory worker.I don't know why saias came.The first to notice that Anne is a different android than the other, cheer her dreams.
